item.title: Oxford-1820 v1.6.7.28
item.description:
Product: Oxford-1820 v1.6.7.28
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 17:16:50 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for controlling the Oxford 18/20 magnet

Release Notes: [1.6.7]
- reconnect automatically when the TCP connection to the IPS/ITC is lost
- detects VISA timeout, connection lost, I/O error, invalid session, resource not found and ID query errors
- reports the error once per outage, then retries in the background (5 s, doubling to a 60 s maximum)
- stops polling and database logging while disconnected
- aborts a running SetMagnet sequence when the connection is lost
- close hardware with a 1 s VISA timeout so the program exits quickly when the instrument is unreachable
- fix exit hanging when closing the program while disconnected
- add Handle Error override (Connection Error Reported?) and Is Connection Error.vi

item.title: Instrument Framework v1.15.13.55
item.description:
Product: Instrument Framework v1.15.13.55
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:21:05 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: An object-oriented framework based on JKI SMOs, developed by the LevyLab at the University of Pittsburgh.

An Instrument developed using this framework will have the access to the following capabilities:

- Framework for communicating with hardware (Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL))
- Periodically polls the instrument for its settings and logs them to a PGSQL database
- Defines an API to allow external programs to control compiled instances of the application and remotely across a network (Either NI's Simple Messaging Library (STM) (deprecated in v1.9) or cross-platform protocol ZMQ (preferred beginning with v1.9))
- Provide a user interface (optional but probably desirable).
- Methods for reading and writing configuration from disk.

Release Notes: [1.15.13]
Performance
- A1: State History.vi moved to Debug library; history depth from Debug attribute (100 normal / 1000 debug); inlined, preallocated reentrant
- A1/A10: OpenG 1D Array to String replaced with LabVIEW primitive (State History, Get SMO Database Paths)
Reliability
- B2: base Handle GET / Handle SET return error 5402 "parameter not supported" for unhandled parameters (previously empty data, no error). Driver overrides should call the parent only in their Default case.
- B14: added user.lib\errors\LevyLab Instrument Framework-errors.txt (reserves codes 5400-5499)
Packaging
- Requires Debug >= 1.2.1.10; removed Instrument UI\State History.vi
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: Transport v2.4.3.52
item.description:
Product: Transport v2.4.3.52
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:58:28 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for scripting and performing transport measurments.

[Control Experiment]
- Control Experiment.vi
- provides a uniform way to record information about your sample & device
- record how the lockin is connected to the device
- configure the Krohn Hite amplifier
- set the base path for saving data
- configure peripheral instruments
- APIs for recording sample data, instrument status

[Transport]
Basic transport measurments:
- Lockin vs time (Lockin_time.vi)
- Lockin Sweep Mode (Lockin_sweep.vi)

[Transport Server]
Server used for scripting and performing asynchronous transport measurments.


Release Notes: #164: fix Lockin_sweep to better handle when V+ = V-
